message:
Bridge Retrofit Engineer, I jointly confirm our host-system mounting interface binding in viewpoint-relative zone language as central twin-mass zone to spring-plus-damper zone to single short transverse cross-beam zone to left beam-end-to-girder-web clamp zone and right beam-end-to-girder-web clamp zone to left girder host zone and right girder host zone.

In plain words the single beam is short transverse-perpendicular between the two main girders at the midspan antinode station, not longitudinal-parallel full-span, viewed between the girders below the soffit looking along the bridge, in the below-top-flange zone within girder depth at and above the bottom flange with nothing above the deck and nothing below the bottom flange, and High-Strength Friction-Grip, defined as High-Strength Friction-Grip (HSFG), clamp bolts live only in those two beam-to-web clamp zones where your callout must land. That orientation and order is what the layout sketch (E55) and the transverse clamp sketch (E74) already show, with two masses, two spring sets, two dampers, one transverse beam and two girder interfaces, and Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), damper axes diagonal per the layout sketch (E55).

Structural Dynamicist and Manager, below-deck clearance forces a centralized midspan pair, not distributed devices along the span.

In plain words only the midspan antinode does full work so splitting units toward the supports wastes steel and multiplies clamps and tuning visits for less motion. Off-antinode effectiveness falls to 0.75 from the modal effectiveness calculation (E67), while the centralized pair keeps travel 49.4 mm from the free-decay simulation (E17) inside 80 mm stops with sag 74.7 mm from the static-sag calculation (E63) totalling 124 mm from the envelope calculation (E68), about a hand span well inside girder depth.

Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor, I confirm the zero-above-deck appearance ban and single-setup from-below service with no deck opening.

In plain words counting added items above the walking surface must read zero, and tuning is reached from below in one closure. All named steel sits between the girders below the soffit within girder depth at midspan per the layout sketch (E55), with lockable service pins for tuning access serviced from below by Below Bridge Access Vehicle, defined as Below Bridge Access Vehicle (BBAV), or girder-bay walkway with no deck hatch, so the four floating flags above the deck are forbidden extra symbols, not named parts. I am ready because transverse orientation, midspan station, below-flange zone, interface binding, clearance and from-below access all survive my strongest buildability objection.
